views.markdown:
A rewrite of CreatureSurvive's Shuffle.

Settings app changes in one place.

* group tweaks, App Store apps & system apps at the top.
* fill in missing tweak icons.
* show the Ethernet row.
* show the Wi-Fi address.
* show cellular data used beside Cellular.
* mask the serial number in About.
* show a different name on the Apple ID row.
* add a banner image to the top of Settings.
* allow installing on iOS 17 and later.

* show the package icon after install.
* add a Tip on Ko-fi row to the credits.
* name the original first in the description.
* credit CreatureSurvive's Shuffle in the description.
